parameters.description_en:
The layout generation uses a user-specified list, which includes both blacklist and whitelist.

Whitelist: specifies which users' video streams to subscribe to in the channel.  
* After configuration, Auto Fill populates slots sequentially based on this list.  
* When switching between multiple layouts in a template, only users in the whitelist are considered.

Blacklist: specifies which users' video streams not to subscribe to in the channel.  
* When switching between multiple layouts in a template, only users not in the blacklist are considered.
parameters.description_zh:
布局生成用户指定列表，包括黑/白名单两种。

白名单，指定订阅房间里哪些用户视频流。
* 设置后自动填充根据该列表进行顺序填充
* 模版多布局切换时只计算白名单中的人

黑名单，指定不订阅房间里哪些用户视频流。
* 模版多布局切换时只计算非黑名单中的人

fields.description_en: Type of user list: blacklist is "black", whitelist is "white".
fields.description_zh: 用户名单类型，黑名单：black，白名单：white。
fields.help_en: Type of user list: blacklist is "black", whitelist is "white"
fields.help_zh: 用户名单类型，黑名单：black，白名单：white

v1_parameters.description_en:
Reserve pane for users who do not publish camera streams.  
The default value is true, which means a pane is reserved for users who do not publish camera streams.  
If set to false, no pane is reserved for such users.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
未推摄像头流用户窗格占位。
默认为true，表示用户未推摄像头流时保留一个窗格。
为false时，表示用户未推摄像头流时不保留窗格。
v1_parameters.name: ReservePaneForNoCameraUser

v1_parameters.description_en:
Whether to display the default pane background when muted.
- true: Display (default value)
- false: Do not display (the configured local pane background is still displayed)
v1_parameters.description_zh:
mute时是否显示窗格默认底图。
- true: 显示（默认值）
- false: 不显示（设置的局部窗格底图依然显示）
v1_parameters.name: ShowDefaultBackgroundOnMute

v1_parameters.description_en:
Whether to allow starting a job when the channel does not exist.
- true: Yes
- false: No (default value)
v1_parameters.description_zh:
是否允许频道不存在时开启任务。

- true: 是
- false: 否（默认值）
v1_parameters.name: StartWithoutChannel

v1_parameters.description_en: This value is valid only when the StartWithoutChannel parameter is true. It specifies the maximum time, in seconds, that a job waits if the channel is not open. The allowed range is [30, 120].
v1_parameters.description_zh: 当StartWithoutChannel参数为true的时候，设置该值才有意义，表示房间未开启时，任务等待时长，单位为秒，区间限制为[30,120]。
v1_parameters.name: StartWithoutChannelWaitTime

v1_parameters.description_en:
Subscribe to a high resolution stream.  
- false: Subscribe to streams with different resolutions based on the pane area. (Default Value)  
- true: By default, fill with the highest resolution stream pushed by the client.
v1_parameters.description_zh:
订阅高分辨率流。
- false：根据窗格面积订阅不同分辨率的流。（默认值）
- true：默认用客户端推的最高分辨率的流进行填充。
v1_parameters.name: SubHighResolutionStream

v1_parameters.description_en: The task ID of this bypass stream ingest job. Only a single ID is supported. It can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens (-), with a maximum length of 55 bytes. If not specified, the System will automatically generate one.
v1_parameters.description_zh: 本次旁路推流的任务ID，仅支持传单个ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大55字节，不填，则由系统自动生成。
v1_parameters.name: TaskId
